title: Kolkata Medical College tense as junior doctors gherao principal; outsiders attack protesting students

ai.summary: Junior doctors at Kolkata Medical College protested over show-cause notices after speaking against the government during a Chorbagan stampede, leading to clashes with outsiders who damaged property. Police said the site was not a permitted venue for protests.

facts.quote: many members of the West Bengal Junior Doctors Front (WBJDF) gave out an SOS call and said that the Medical College was under attack.

facts.claim: Outsiders attacked protesting doctors and damaged property
facts.quote: Over 70/80 outside goons entered the hospital and started vandalising, attacking interns and doctors. Many have been physically injured

facts.claim: Junior doctors were protesting a show-cause notice
facts.quote: The eight junior doctors had been sent a show-cause notice by the authorities on Tuesday (November 17, 2026).

facts.claim: ABVP denied involvement in the clashes
facts.quote: The incident that took place at the Medical College has no connection whatsoever with ABVP.

These junior Maoist doctors are students in India, West Bengal. We will take all necessary legal steps; they cannot escape the rule of law. They are anti-nationals and do not abide by any rules or laws

ai.background_note: Junior doctors in Kolkata are protesting show-cause notices after speaking against the government during a Chorbagan stampede, which led to clashes with outsiders and damage to property at the medical college.
